arxiv-2305-18583.title: Controllable Text-to-Image Generation with GPT-4
arxiv-2305-18583.creator: Tianjun Zhang, Yi Zhang, Vibhav Vineet, Neel Joshi, Xin Wang
arxiv-2305-18583.description: Abstract Current text-to-image generation models often struggle to follow textual instructions, especially the ones requiring spatial reasoning. On the other hand, Large Language Models (LLMs), such as GPT-4, have shown remarkable precision in generating code snippets for sketching out text inputs graphically, e.g., via TikZ.

arxiv-2409-14711.title: Stronger Nonlocality in GHZ States: A Step Beyond the Conventional GHZ Paradox
arxiv-2409-14711.creator: Ananya Chakraborty, Kunika Agarwal, Sahil Gopalkrishna Naik, Manik Banik
arxiv-2409-14711.description: Abstract The Greenberger–Horne–Zeilinger (GHZ) paradox, involving quantum systems with three or more subsystems, offers an all-vs-nothing test of quantum nonlocality. Unlike Bell tests for bipartite systems, which reveal statistical contradictions, the GHZ paradox demonstrates a definitive (i.e. 1 1 00%) conflict between local hidden variable theories and quantum mechanics.

arxiv-2501-19326.title: On the minimal components of substitution subshifts
arxiv-2501-19326.creator: Raphaël Henry
arxiv-2501-19326.description: Abstract In this paper we study substitutions on A ℤ A^{\mathbb{Z}} where A A is a finite alphabet. We precisely characterize the minimal components of substitution subshifts, give an optimal bound for their number and describe their dynamics. The explicitness of these results provides a method to algorithmically compute and count the minimal components of a given substitution subshift.

arxiv-2502-10072.title: 2025 IEEE International Students’ Conference on Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Science LifeSaver: Predictive Load Limit Estimation for Transport Vehicles in Hilly Areas Thanks: 979-8-3315-2983-3/25/$31.00 ©2025 IEEE
arxiv-2502-10072.creator: Vaibhav Chopra, Chanakya Rao, Moksh Soni, Prashant Mishra
arxiv-2502-10072.description: Abstract The transportation of essential goods in mountainous regions faces severe logistical challenges and frequent disruptions. To mitigate these difficulties, transport companies often overload trucks, which, though cost-saving, significantly heightens the risk of accidents and mechanical failures. This paper presents the development of a device that detects overloaded and insecurely fastened loads on trucks and commercial vehicles.

arxiv-2506-12250.title: Interpretable Classification of Levantine Ceramic Thin Sections via Neural Networks Journal: Machine Learning: Science and Technology
arxiv-2506-12250.creator: Sara Capriotti, Alessio Devoto, Simone Scardapane, Silvano Mignardi, Laura Medeghini
arxiv-2506-12250.description: Abstract Classification of ceramic thin sections is fundamental for understanding ancient pottery production techniques, provenance, and trade networks. Although effective, traditional petrographic analysis is time-consuming. This study explores the application of deep learning models, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Vision Transformers (ViTs), as complementary tools to support the classification of Levantine ceramics based on their petrographic fabrics .

arxiv-2506-23922.title: Thermodynamics of Hard Sphere and Spherocylinder Mixtures – Scaled Particle Theory and Monte Carlo Simulations
arxiv-2506-23922.creator: Remco Tuinier
arxiv-2506-23922.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Remco Tuinier. We review the literature on scaled particle theory (SPT) and its extensions and discuss results applied to describe the thermodynamics of hard particle mixtures. After explaining the basic concepts of scaled particle theory to compute the free energy of immersing a particle into a mixture, examples are discussed for the simple case of a hard sphere dispersion and the free volume fraction of ghost spheres in a hard sphere dispersion.

arxiv-2510-03200.title: MonSTeR : a Unified Model for Motion, Scene, Text Retrieval
arxiv-2510-03200.creator: Luca Collorone, Matteo Gioia, Massimiliano Pappa, Paolo Leoni, Giovanni Ficarra, Or Litany, Indro Spinelli, Fabio Galasso, [0.6em] Sapienza University of Rome
arxiv-2510-03200.description: Abstract Intention drives human movement in complex environments, but such movement can only happen if the surrounding context supports it. Despite the intuitive nature of this mechanism, existing research has not yet provided tools to evaluate the alignment between skeletal movement ( motion ), intention ( text ), and the surrounding context ( scene ).

arxiv-2602-08359.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by XinXin Qi, Hao Sun. We also introduce another singlet scalar S 0 S_{0} with a non-zero vacuum expectation value to the SM so that the fermion dark matter can obtain mass after spontaneous symmetry breaking.

pmc-10914036.description: Pregnant women have a number of physiological changes that lower the immune responses to avoid embryonic rejection, which increases the risk of problems after contracting coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19). pmc-11403997.title: Concurrent analysis of genome and transcriptome in one single cell
pmc-11403997.creator: Johanna Heid, Ronald Cutler, Moonsook Lee, Jan Vijg, Alexander Y. Maslov
pmc-11403997.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Thus far, multiple techniques for single cell analysis have been developed, yet we lack a relatively simple tool to assess DNA and RNA from the same cell at whole-transcriptome and whole-genome depths. Here we present an updated method for physical separation of cytoplasmic RNA from the nuclei, which allows for simultaneous studies of DNA and RNA from the same single cell.

pmc-11691282.creator: Allyson Brothers, LIza Behrens, Carrie Leach
pmc-11691282.description: Community-engaged research is essential for identifying and supporting the needs of an aging society and ensuring effective translation of research findings. pmc-12469688.title: Unveiling Cryptic BCR-ABL1 Rearrangements: Diagnostic Challenges and Clinical Impact in Myeloid Malignancies
pmc-12469688.creator: Anna Ferrari, Chiara Salvesi, Eugenio Fonzi, Barbara Giannini, Michela Tonelli, Irene Zacheo, Matteo Paganelli, Federico Lo Schiavo, Marco Rosetti, Giorgia Simonetti, Giovanni Marconi
pmc-12469688.description: Chromosomal BCR-ABL1 fusions are the defining molecular lesions of chronic myeloid leukemia (CML) and Philadelphia-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia, and are rarely observed in acute myeloid leukemia. Their detection have transformed treatment paradigms by enabling effective use of specific tyrosine kinase inhibitors (TKIs).

pmc-12506886.title: Synthesis, biological evaluation, and docking analysis of novel benzimidazole–triazole hybrids as potential anticancer agents
pmc-12506886.creator: Amir Shervin Shokouhi Asl, Sara Ranjbar, Mohammad Hosein Sayahi, Zahra Dehghani, Amir Mohammad Taherkhani, Manica Negahdaripour, Navid Dastyafteh, Mina Emami, Sajedeh Safapoor, Abbas Ghahramani, Mohammad Reza Mohajeri-Tehrani, Bagher Larijani, Mohammad Mahdavi, Younes Ghasemi
pmc-12506886.description: A series of novel benzimidazole–triazole acetamide hybrids with different substitutions at the acetamide moiety were designed and synthesized in an effort to discover potential anticancer agents. The compounds were evaluated for their in vitro antiproliferative and cytotoxicity activities against two cancer cell lines (A549 and SW480) and a normal cell (MRC-5) using the MTT assay.

pmc-13042686.title: A humanized NOG‐EXL mouse model for producing severe fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome virus–reactive human antibodies
pmc-13042686.creator: Dong Hoon Lee, Jiyeong Bae, Sumi Kim, Chan Young Song, Jung Hyu Shin, Eun Hee Kim, Chan Ho Jang, Young‐sun Yun, Dong‐sook Lee, Hyuk Chu, Jang‐Hoon Choi, Chan Woo Kim
pmc-13042686.description: BackgroundHumanized mouse models are essential for studying the human immune response and antibody development. However, conventional models show limited B cell maturation and antigen‐specific humoral responses. To overcome these limitations, we used the NOG‐EXL mice expressing human interleukin 3 (IL‐3) and granulocyte‐macrophage colony‐stimulating factor (GM‐CSF) to enhance myeloid and B‐cell lineage differentiation.

pmc-13096027.title: Beyond passive exposure: active engagement and green behavior amplify urban wellbeing
pmc-13096027.creator: Ning Chen, Yifan Kang
pmc-13096027.description: Environmental conditions are increasingly recognized as important determinants of population health and wellbeing. However, the mechanisms linking environmental experiences to wellbeing remain insufficiently understood. Prior research rarely distinguishes between active environmental engagement and subjective environmental appraisal. It also typically examines these pathways in isolation. This study addresses this gap by using a pathway-specific multi-theory framework.

pmc-13654373.creator: Shuhong Wang, Yin Tian, Xiangui Zhou, Peng Wang, Zhiheng Jiang, Ruilie Wang, Changqiang Liang, Guang Yang, Peng Ye, Anyong Yu, Tinggang Wang
pmc-13654373.description: Thoracic injuries due to severe trauma are common, but major airway rupture is a rare and fatal complication. When a patient suddenly loses effective ventilation, extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) is an effective rescue method to ensure gas exchange. ECMO can play an important role for patients with severe airway injury who do not respond to conventional treatments.
